description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/edit-workspace-transactions: the parent Update invalidated the held child (3420) and the level had ended by the time of Rollback and CommitTrans (3034), so the tx-commit step was not exercised and it is not known which call ended the level. On a writable r-cplx-rebuild-cx-mv-text: dynaset rs on the parents p1 and p2, its Tags field, the child recordset c1 of p1; Workspaces(0).BeginTrans; rs.Edit; c1.AddNew, Value = 'tx-rollback', c1.Update (DBEngine.Errors); no parent Update; the state of c1 (RecordCount, BOF, EOF); Workspace.Rollback (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); the group of p1 read through a new recordset and through a fresh Workspace opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
